Name: ALM_001
InfoText: Causes: button pressed or wire break. Action: check the area, release the emergency stop (Commands screen or the contact), then reset.

Name: ALM_002
AlarmText: SOURCE LEVEL LOW: DRY RUN RISK
InfoText: Causes: source empty or sensor fault. Action: check the source supply and the sensor. Clears by itself when the source recovers.

Name: ALM_003
AlarmText: TANK LEVEL CRITICAL HIGH: OVERFLOW RISK
InfoText: Causes: pump not stopped at the high level or level sensor drift. Action: check the level sensor and the stop logic, check the consumption, then reset.

Name: ALM_004
InfoText: Causes: closed valve, clogged filter, leak, dry run or sensor fault. Action: check valves and filter, inspect pump 1, then reset.

Name: ALM_005
InfoText: Causes: closed valve, clogged filter, leak, dry run or sensor fault. Action: check valves and filter, inspect pump 2, then reset.

Name: ALM_006
InfoText: Causes: protection tripped, contactor failure, overload or wire break. Action: inspect pump 1, contactor and protection, then reset.

Name: ALM_007
InfoText: Causes: protection tripped, contactor failure, overload or wire break. Action: inspect pump 2, contactor and protection, then reset.

Name: ALM_008_TANK
InfoText: Causes: wire break, sensor failure or scaling error. Action: check the wiring and the level sensor, then reset.

Name: ALM_009
InfoText: Causes: both pumps faulted or low flow on both. Action: repair at least one pump, then reset.

Name: ALM_010
InfoText: Causes: tight thresholds, leak or noisy level signal. Action: review the level thresholds and check for leaks.

Name: WRN_002_P1
InfoText: Causes: overload or mechanical friction. Action: schedule an inspection.

Name: WRN_002_P2
InfoText: Causes: overload or mechanical friction. Action: schedule an inspection.

Name: WRN_003_P1
InfoText: Cause: maintenance interval reached. Action: schedule maintenance, then reset the hours in Maintenance mode.

Name: WRN_003_P2
InfoText: Cause: maintenance interval reached. Action: schedule maintenance, then reset the hours in Maintenance mode.

Name: WRN_004
InfoText: Causes: leak, excessive consumption, flow sensor error or pump wear. Action: check the consumption and the line, inspect the pump.

Name: ALM_008_OTHER
InfoText: Causes: wire break, sensor failure or scaling error on flow, pressure, source level or a current. Action: check the wiring and the sensor.
